response.sql: WITH qc_by_funding AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.fundflux, 'Missing') as fundflux, COUNT(*) as qc_count FROM scanqc sq INNER JOIN projects p ON sq.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY COALESCE(p.fundflux, 'Missing')) SELECT fundflux, qc_count, qc_count * 1.0 / SUM(qc_count) OVER () as fraction_of_total, qc_count * 1.0 * COUNT(*) OVER () / SUM(qc_count) OVER () as ratio_to_average FROM qc_by_funding ORDER BY fundflux
